stories.title: US STRIKES HIT IRANIAN CIVILIAN WATER INFRASTRUCTURE — 20,000 WITHOUT WATER
stories.event: US military strikes reportedly hit drinking water storage tanks in the Bamani district of Sirik county, Hormozgan province, Iran. 20,000 people are now without potable water. This is the first confirmed report of strikes hitting civilian water infrastructure in Iran.
stories.context_timeline: Ongoing escalation sequence: 15:45-15:56 UTC — Trump alternates between 'will attack Iran hard' / 'hit them again hard today' and 'deal is fully negotiated, just need to sign'. 15:51 UTC — Israeli jets over southern Lebanon and Bekaa. 16:15 UTC — Trump says US seized 22 Iranian oil ships in covert ops. 16:23 UTC — B-52 strategic bomber detected from Sicily heading Middle East, transponder off. 16:59 UTC — French soldier killed in Lebanon training accident. 17:04 UTC — US strikes confirmed hitting civilian water infrastructure in Hormozgan.
stories.consensus: Market pricing this as 'limited military strikes' / 'negotiating leverage theater'. SPY -1.08%. Oil +3% but not spiking parabolic. Consensus narrative: 'Both sides have off-ramps, deal gets signed this week.' VIX at 21.91 is elevated but not panic (was 18.92 prev close).
stories.contradiction: Hitting civilian WATER STORAGE TANKS is not 'limited strikes on military targets'. This is infrastructure warfare — the same playbook used against civilian power grids and water in other theaters. 20,000 civilians without water is a humanitarian escalation that will generate global headlines. Combined with a B-52 nuclear-capable bomber vectoring east with transponder off: this is a deliberate escalation narrative, not negotiation theater. The market consensus is WRONG. This is not a contained conflict — the US is systematically degrading Iranian civilian infrastructure.

stories.title: B-52 STRATEGIC BOMBER VECTOR MIDDLE EAST — TRANSPONDER OFF — STILL UNRESOLVED (47 MIN OLD)
stories.event: KAN News reporter: B-52 strategic American bomber detected on flight tracking heading from US base in Sicily toward the Middle East. Plane turned off transmitter — flight path unknown. Nuclear-capable strategic bomber. Still no confirmation of landing location or mission outcome as of 17:10 UTC.
stories.consensus: Market pricing: 'B-52 is standard deterrence posture, not a strike mission.' Oil up but not parabolic. The B-52 news is being dismissed as saber-rattling.
stories.contradiction: 47 minutes have passed. The B-52 either landed at an undisclosed location in the Middle East (operational security) or has already conducted/joined a strike package. Combined with the confirmed water infrastructure strike at 17:04 UTC — the B-52 was NOT deterrence. It was mission-ready ordnance heading to theater. The fact that its landing hasn't been announced means it's either still airborne on a mission or parked at a secured base for follow-on strikes. Either way, the 'deterrence' narrative is dead.

stories.title: FRENCH SOLDIER KILLED IN LEBANON — TRAINING ACCIDENT DURING HEIGHTENED TENSIONS
stories.event: French Private First Class Florian Gillet of the 8th RPIMa died in Lebanon from accidental gunfire during training preparation. He was part of an operational partnership mission for the Lebanese Armed Forces. This occurs while Israeli jets are actively over southern Lebanon and the Bekaa Valley.
stories.consensus: Not market-relevant — training accident, no political implications.
stories.contradiction: A French soldier dying in Lebanon — even accidentally — during a period where Israeli jets are bombing Lebanese territory (Bekaa strike at 15:23 UTC) and French forces are training with the Lebanese military creates a layered diplomatic risk. France already has complex relations in Lebanon (UNIFIL mandate, historical ties, large diaspora). A French service member's death, even accidental, during an active Israeli bombing campaign will draw French parliamentary scrutiny. Macron's government is already fragile — this could force political statements or diplomatic demarches that alter the multi-front calculus. Not a market mover directly, but a compounding risk factor.

bet.instrument: Watch EUR/USD, French bond spreads for reaction
bet.rationale: If France recalls or reduces its Lebanon mission, it signals NATO fracture on Middle East policy. Lower probability but high impact on EUR if it escalates.
